abstract: No risk factor other than cryptorchidism has been consistently associated with testicular cancer, and the influence of diet on testicular cancer risk has not been extensively explored. A few studies have found increased testicular cancer risk in men whose diets are high in fat, red meats, and milk or low in fruits and vegetables. We evaluated the relationship of dietary factors and risk of testicular cancer and also examined whether this risk varied by type of testicular cancer. We conducted a hospital-based case-control study at The University of Texas M. D. Anderson Cancer Center (Houston, TX) of 160 testicular cancer cases diagnosed between 1990 and 1996 and 136 friend-matched controls. The results of multivariable logistic regression analysis showed that after adjustment for age, education, income, ethnicity, cryptorchidism, and total daily calories, increasing total fat, saturated fat, and cholesterol consumption were associated with increasing risk of nonseminoma testicular cancer, with odds ratios (ORs) for the highest vs. the lowest quartiles of 6.3, 5.3, and 4.6, respectively. The risk for seminoma testicular cancer marginally increased with increasing intake of total fat and saturated fat, with ORs for the highest vs. lowest quartiles of 1.9 and 2.1, respectively. Higher total fat consumption was nearly significantly related to increased mixed germ cell tumor risk, with an OR for highest vs. lowest quartile of 4.2. This study supports the hypothesis that diet (particularly high fat consumption) increases testicular cancer risk in young men. However, the small sample size and the possibility that these observations may be due to bias indicate that the relationship of diet and testicular cancer risk needs to be further examined within a prospective or incident case-control study.
abstract_ja: 食事因子と精巣がんのリスクの関係を評価し、このリスクが精巣がんの種類によって異なるかも検討しました。1990年から1996年の間に診断された精巣がん症例160例と、友人によるマッチング対照136例を対象に、テキサス大学MDアンダーソンがんセンター(テキサス州ヒューストン)で病院ベースの症例対照研究を実施しました。多変量ロジスティック回帰分析の結果、年齢、教育、所得、民族、停留精巣、総カロリー摂取量で調整後、総脂肪、飽和脂肪、コレステロール摂取量の増加は非セミノーマ精巣がんのリスク増加と関連しました。最高四分位と最低四分位の比較によるオッズ比は、それぞれ6.3、5.3、4.6でした。セミノーマ精巣がんのリスクは、総脂肪および飽和脂肪摂取量の増加に伴いわずかに上昇し、最高四分位と最低四分位のオッズ比はそれぞれ1.9および2.1でした。総脂肪摂取量の増加は、混合型胚細胞腫瘍のリスク増加とほぼ有意に関連し、最高四分位と最低四分位のオッズ比は4.2でした。本研究は、特に高脂肪摂取が若年男性の精巣がんリスクを高めるという仮説を支持します。ただし、症例数が少ないこと、また観察結果がバイアスによる可能性があることから、食事と精巣がんリスクの関係は、前向き研究または発生症例対照研究によってさらに検討する必要があります。
